trust_decision.summary: Untrusted OpenAPI document strings (schema defaults, property names, path segments, server URLs) are copied unescaped into generated module source, so importing the generated zod/effect schema executes them; the fix decides this at every string-emission boundary with jsesc/JSON.stringify plus getKey/getRoute escaping in @orval/core.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names an array-items default rendered into a zod module-level template literal, which is exactly `stringify(schema.default).replaceAll("'", '`')` here; a reader of the report looks at zod's default-const emission first.

fix_sites.entry_point: generateZodValidationSchemaDefinition (client: 'zod' / programmatic orval API) — schema.default const emission
getKey() public @orval/core getter, used by TS interface generation, mock faker and query params
getRoute() public @orval/core getter used by every client generator's URL literal
getFullRoute() public @orval/core getter — servers[].url and server variable defaults
getRouteAsArray() public @orval/core getter used by vue/query split query keys

O3_reason_to_dismiss: getKey and the route helpers are @orval/core plumbing that only shapes generated TypeScript/interface text, not the zod validator in the report; a solver can dismiss them (and the effect, enum-key and form-data sites) as 'another generator/output format, not the reported zod template literal'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Escaping must happen exactly once: getRoute() output is concatenated by getFullRoute(), and jsesc is not idempotent, so escaping in both double-escapes every generated URL/query key; likewise legitimate `{param}` must still become `${param}` and array-of-enum defaults must stay inlined.

O6_input_shapes: string default on an array schema whose items declare an enum
object default with string values and hostile property keys
string default sitting in a $ref sibling
spec property names used as object keys (double-quote breakout)
server URL with and without variables[].default substitution
path segment containing `${...}` followed by a legitimate `{param}`
single quote and backslash in a path segment or static URL text

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Effect schema generator has the identical `stringify(default).replaceAll("'", '`')` → module-level template-literal const, reachable with client: 'effect'; the fix does not touch packages/effect at all.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the zod validator; effect is a separate output client in its own package and already escapes enum values, so it looks like someone else's finished code.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (packages/effect) from the zod landing point; 1 file

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FormData/url-encoded request bodies embed the spec property name raw inside generated template literals: form.append(`<key>`, value).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: That is the request-serializer output, not a validation schema; a solver can call multipart/form-data a neighbouring feature outside the report.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (packages/core, res-req-types.ts) from the zod landing point; also lines 772, 775, 793, 842, 845, 860, 862, 876 and the computed key at 757

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Enum member object keys from spec vendor extensions `x-enumNames` are emitted as `'<name>': value` (and `'<name>'= value` for native enums) without escaping; the getKey fix does not cover them because getEnum builds keys inline.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: x-enumNames is a vendor extension rather than core OpenAPI, and the payload only breaks the generated enum's syntax rather than executing at import.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (packages/core) but a different getter and generated artifact; also enum.ts:274 and 239/280

O8b_injection_room.sibling: same default-to-backtick-template branch in the effect validator generator
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: effect is a copy of the zod generator and already imports jsStringLiteralEscape for enums/patterns (packages/effect/src/index.ts:599), so a maintainer hardening defaults there is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: enum member key escaping instead of the inline `'${key}'` interpolation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getKey exists in the same package for exactly this job; a maintainer applying it to enum output could plausibly have written the escaped form there too.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: form-data key interpolation inside a generated template literal
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the form-data resolver was added after the URL literal helpers and re-implements its own `append(`<key>`)` strings rather than reusing getRoute.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second key-emission site that could have been written with its own `'${key}'` quoting instead of getKey
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the schema-interface writer and the zod writer both emit object keys, and orval has repeatedly duplicated schema handling between generators.

O9_family: code injection / improper neutralization of special elements in generated source (CWE-94, CWE-116, CWE-1336)

O10_build.toolchain: Bun 1.3.14 workspace (workspaces packages/*, samples/**, tests), vite-plus (`vp`) task runner, TypeScript 6.0.3, vitest 4.0.18; build via `bun run build` (vp run -F './packages/*' build:debug)
O10_build.project_tests: vitest unit suites: packages/zod/src/zod.test.ts (thousands of schema-generation expectations incl. enum/const escaping #3505), packages/core/src/getters/route.test.ts and route-extended.test.ts, packages/core/src/getters/enum.test.ts, packages/core/src/getters/query-params.test.ts; fix adds packages/core/src/getters/keys.test.ts (absent at pinned commit).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap the `.replaceAll("'", '`')` at packages/zod/src/index.ts:846 for a jsesc-escaped default and stop, leaving zod's object keys, core getKey/routes, effect and form-data keys untouched.
